original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. actual_scope: On the single length-42 block word recorded in PR #7041, 350122222224444444000000111111333333555555, run the same 903-pair predicate and classify the other 61 nonzero masks as realized or missed. The two named targets (3, 5) and (0, 1, 3, 5) stay in the scan only as a predicate control.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one new connector operation. This package keeps the unsigned dirty connector alphabet fixed and answers open question 1 of PR #7041: which of the other 61 nonzero masks this one block word misses. A new operation is not the missing step. The family expansion gate is not invoked.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the recursive-interface schedule. A depth-two block needs every nonzero mask. PR #7041 shows that this block word realizes (3, 5) and (0, 1, 3, 5), and leaves the other 61 unclassified. The census says which of those 61 this word misses. No supplier, consumer, or selected kappa changes.
stop_rule: Stop once this one named block word has been classified on all 903 pairs for all 63 nonzero masks, with the other 61 listed as realized or missed. Do not replace the question with a census of every floor word, with an adjacent transposition of the #7037 witness, or with a depth-two existence claim.
evidence: The block word calls each of six sources seven times. The exhaustive 903-pair census realizes 13 nonzero masks and misses 50. Of the other 61, 11 are realized, at 19 pairs, and 50 have no realizing pair. The two target controls remain the six pairs recorded in PR #7041. A level-set argument on source 5 shows that the full mask is missed: only 73 pairs can turn that bit on, and none of them reads as all six bits. Four pairs read as the zero mask and 874 pairs have no reading. This is an inventory of one word. It is not a depth-two block and not an unrestricted existence claim. The selected kappa is unchanged.
